title: Dual public paths in jmap-types and jmap-server
description: Follow-up from JMAP-skk9.13 (verify leftovers of JMAP-wf92.26/.27). jmap-types exposes pub mod backend plus a root pub use backend::{GetObject, JmapObject, QueryObject, SetObject} (lib.rs:33,51). jmap-server exposes pub mod backend and pub mod handlers and also re-exports their items at the crate root (lib.rs:35-49). JMAP-wf92.20 is closed, but it fixed only the extension crates. The one-public-path rule (JMAP-wf92.13/.20/.26) is not applied to these two core crates. Decision needed: make the modules private (BREAKING, touches every jmap_server::handlers::/backend:: path in the workspace) or document them as exempt.
close_reason: fixed by wf92.23: jmap-types lib.rs:33 'mod backend' (e8a7b911), jmap-server lib.rs:35-36 private backend/handlers (6c357533); no pub mod left in either
